sections.label: POHA covers entities and individuals
sections.summary: The Protection from Harassment Act covers both entities such as companies and individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: For part (a) of the Parliamentary Question by the Member, the Protection from Harassment Act (POHA) covers both entities, such as companies and individuals.

sections.label: POHA amendment on entity liability
sections.summary: POHA was amended in May to clarify entities can be liable, be victims, seek relief and be criminally liable.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: POHA was amended in May this year to clarify that entities can be liable for contraventions and that entities can be victims and seek relief under POHA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There are a part (a), part (b) and part (c) to it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, actually, the entities can be criminally liable.

sections.label: Section 5 threatening communication prohibition
sections.summary: Under section 5 of POHA, an individual or entity must not use threatening, abusive or insulting communication towards another person.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under section 5 of POHA, it also states that an individual or entity must not by any means use towards another person any threatening, abusive or insulting communication to another person.

sections.label: Challenges in corporate criminal responsibility rules
sections.summary: Creating new rules on corporate criminal responsibility involves challenges, balancing protecting employees from harassment against not unduly burdening businesses or employers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second question, I would just like to add that there are challenges involved in creating new rules relating to corporate criminal responsibility.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I take the Member's point that there is a need to protect employees from harassment but, on the other hand, there is also a need to ensure that the burden on businesses or employers is not unduly onerous.

sections.label: Measures against workplace violence and harassment
sections.summary: Minister Josephine Teo said the Ministry of Manpower put in place practical measures to eliminate workplace violence and harassment, and employers must meet the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Without repeating the details that transpired, Minister Josephine Teo had talked about how the Ministry of Manpower has put in place practical measures to eliminate workplace violence and harassment, and also that employers must meet the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices.
